intro: We make small, silly phone games you can learn in five seconds and lose to in thirty. No accounts needed. Just one more try.

games.name: Snack Stuck
games.tagline: Your snack is stuck. Rock the machine free, and try not to get squished.
description: You paid. You pressed the button. Your snack got stuck. Meet Vendy, the smuggest vending machine alive, and rock him back and forth until the snack drops.
Tap in rhythm to build combos, watch the tilt meter, and stop before the red zone, or Vendy falls on you. Every squish can be replayed in slow motion and shared.
features: 8 worlds, from an office to a space station
6 players, including Grandma and The Cat
37 snacks and rare items to collect
Instant replay of your best squish
games.videoCaption: Rock Vendy in rhythm, grab the golden snacks, and stop before he tips over. Real gameplay, recorded straight from the game.
games.extraPrivacy: If you tap "Share clip", the game makes a short video of your last run on your device and hands it to the app you pick (for example WhatsApp or TikTok). We never upload clips ourselves.
faq: I lost my progress.
Progress is saved only on your phone. Uninstalling the game or clearing its data deletes it, and we cannot restore it.
The ad for a revive didn't give me anything.
The reward is given when the ad finishes. If you close it early or it fails to load, try again in a moment.
Can I play offline?
Yes. Ads need a connection, but the game itself works offline.

games.name: Color Pour
games.tagline: Draw chalk ramps, guide the falling sand, and fill every jar with the right color.
description: Colored sand pours from the spouts. Draw chalk ramps to guide it into the matching jars, and keep the colors apart. One wrong grain makes mud, and the jar gets sick.

New tricks keep arriving: dye tubes that turn white sand red, fans that blow it sideways, gates you open at the right moment, portals, bounce pads and jars that ride a conveyor belt. Solve the daily pour for a week of prizes, and spend the drops you earn in the Lab Shop.
features: Draw a line, watch the sand flow
Dyes, fans, gates, portals and bounce pads
Earn drops and shop for chalk, sand and lab themes
faq: The sand turned into mud.
A wrong color got into a jar. Your lines are kept, so nudge one and pour again.
How do I move my progress to a new phone?
Choose "Sign in with Google" in the game on your old phone, then sign in with the same account on the new one.
How do I delete my data?
Email us with the words "delete my Color Pour data" and, if you signed in, the Google account you used. We delete it within 30 days.
games.videoCaption: Draw a ramp, pour the sand, and watch the jars cheer. Real gameplay, recorded straight from the game.

games.name: Meowtiply
games.tagline: Multiply your cats, pick the right gates and smash giant robo bosses with laser eyes.
description: Start with one cat. Swipe through math gates to multiply your swarm, and end up with ten thousand. Fire laser eyes at cube walls, beat greedy dog packs and take down giant robo bosses with a tidal wave of cats.

Pick the better gate every time: plus, times, minus or divide. Grab weapons, dodge beach balls and falling meteors, then watch your swarm stack into a living cat tower at the finish for up to five times the rewards.
features: One finger, one minute a level
70 levels across 7 worlds, from a sunny village to a moon base
12 cat breeds to collect, and the whole swarm wears the coat
A free cat every few wins and a daily gift that grows each day
games.videoCaption: Start with one cat, pick the right gates and end with thousands. Real gameplay, recorded straight from the game.

The ad for a bonus didn't give me anything.
The reward is given when the ad finishes. If you close it early or it fails to load, try again in a moment.
Can I play offline?
Yes. Ads need a connection, but the game itself works offline.
Where is the privacy choice for ads?
In Settings, tap Privacy settings (shown where the law requires it) to change your ad consent at any time.
